channel.description: Latest articles from Religion News Service (religionnews.com)

item.title: Money Conversations with Kids
item.description: A practical conversation about raising financially confident and spiritually anchored kids in a complicated world.

item.title: New Orleans celebrates Mardi Gras, the indulgent conclusion of Carnival season
item.description: NEW ORLEANS, La. (AP) — Mardi Gras, also known as Fat Tuesday, marks the climax and end of the weekslong Carnival season and a final chance for indulgence, feasting and revelry before the Christian Lent period of sacrifice and reflection.

item.title: Belgium summons U.S. ambassador over tweet accusing kingdom of antisemitism
item.description: “Labeling Belgium as antisemitic is not just wrong, it’s dangerous disinformation that undermines the real fight against hatred,” said Belgian foreign minister Maxime Prévot in a post on X on Monday.

item.title: Cardinal Tobin leads Ash Wednesday Masses inside New Jersey ICE facility
item.description: NEWARK, N.J. (RNS) — The Newark bishops are the only confirmed U.S. bishops who plan to celebrate Ash Wednesday Mass in an ICE detention facility.

item.title: 400 Christian leaders urge resistance to Trump administration on Ash Wednesday
item.description: The statement’s signers include a mix of denominational leaders, seminary presidents, scholars and leaders of prominent congregations.

item.title: Photos of the Week: Carnival traditions, Ramadan begins
item.description: Each week RNS presents a gallery of photos of religious expression around the world. This week’s photo selection includes Carnival traditions around the world, the start of Ramadan, Ash Wednesday and more.

item.title: Mormons are opening up about sex, says therapist
item.description: Fife used to get hate mail for saying words like ‘clitoris’ out loud. Now her classes and podcasts are in high demand.

item.title: Jesse Jackson’s complex history with American Jews
item.description: Jackson was a great and complicated man. And a rock star told a part of his story.

item.title: How should Muslims talk to their youth about the risks of activism?
item.description: In households where religious practice is linked with standing against injustice, how do parents guide children engaged in various forms of activism?

item.title: David E. Anderson, former RNS editor and longtime journalist, dies at 84
item.description: ‘He was a legend by the time I got to meet him,’ said journalist Ira Rifkin of his future supervisor David Anderson. ‘He just seemed to know everything.’
